column1: •        Most stations had power management enabled on the USB ports (controllers/hubs).  This can cause our sensors to lose proper connection with the computer they are connected to.  I disabled  power management.

column3: so IT needs to disable SMB1 everywhere.  This would explain the weird slowness I said I was “feeling” while connected in.  I have a strong feeling this is a major cause of issues.
